confidence_scope: The observed single-seed pilot and lack of incremental deployment benefit, not a universal claim about PPO or GNNs.
what_results_support: Correct retained on-policy training and reward/checkpoint contracts within the stated model.
PPO retained the frozen BC root-STOP greedy behavior on all 24 development scenes at all three checkpoints.
Higher return than continuing rules is reproduced by the simple shared-menu STOP control.
Frozen Fixed3 yields the same cost with lower complete planning time.
what_results_dont_support: Incremental learned conditional multistep planning benefit.
Across-seed, cross-scale or physical IK reliability.
Exact lifetime physical training cost after the interrupted uncommitted rollout.
PPO alone caused the initial greedy STOP behavior.

Independent development evidence isolating actor/critic/exploration causes.
Fresh held-out data and multiple seeds only after a new preregistered positive pilot.
Matched monotone/nonmonotone training if a mechanism claim is later pursued.
